title: Tony's warehouse: commercial property and business income
summary: Follow Tony's new Detroit warehouse for a year: the three forms, Basic vs Broad vs Special, vacancy, coinsurance, Business Income and key endorsements.
objectives: Tell what the Broad and Special causes of loss forms add to Basic
Apply the 60-day vacancy rule and the 31% test, and work a coinsurance problem
Separate Business Income from Extra Expense and their start times
Match the endorsements and the condo, builders risk and legal liability forms

scenes.title: Tony's warehouse: commercial property and business income
scenes.subtitle: Causes of loss, vacancy, coinsurance, Business Income and endorsements, on the ISO commercial property forms

beats.text: Tony's Pizza is booming. In November, Tony buys an old Detroit warehouse for a bigger kitchen. Dana insures it.
beats.say: Tony's Pizza is booming. In November, Tony buys an old Detroit warehouse for a bigger kitchen. Dana insures it.

beats.text: Big building. What could go wrong?
beats.say: Big building. What could go wrong?

scenes.title: Three forms to start Tony's coverage
scenes.src: ISO CP 00 90 07 88, D.; MCL 500.2833(1)(q); ISO CP 00 10 10 12, A.1; vs_commercial-05; ms_commercial-05

draw.text: Michigan: paused from loss report to formal denial

draw.label: Key form: Building and Personal Property

beats.text: Dana starts Tony's coverage with three forms. First, the Commercial Property Conditions: shared rules.
beats.say: Dana starts Tony's coverage with three forms. First, the Commercial Property Conditions: shared rules.

beats.text: Its 1988 version allows 2 years after a loss to sue. In Michigan, that clock pauses from his loss report until a formal denial.
beats.say: Its nineteen eighty-eight version allows two years after a loss to sue. In Michigan, that clock pauses from his loss report until a formal denial.

beats.text: Second, the key form: the 2012 Building and Personal Property form, or BPP. It covers the building and Tony's business personal property, in it or within 100 feet.
beats.say: Second, the key form: the twenty twelve Building and Personal Property form, or B P P. It covers the building and Tony's business personal property, in it or within one hundred feet.

beats.text: Plus others' property in his care, like his supplier's cooler. Third, a causes of loss form: Basic, Broad or Special. Tony picks Basic.
beats.say: Plus others' property in his care, like his supplier's cooler. Third, a causes of loss form: Basic, Broad or Special. Tony picks Basic.

scenes.title: Basic, Broad or Special?
scenes.src: ISO CP 10 10 10 12, A.1-11; CP 10 20 10 12, A.12-14, C.; CP 10 30 09 17, A.; adapted from hook mn_comm-09; cp_commercial-06

draw.text: Fire, lightning, explosion, windstorm or hail,
smoke, aircraft or vehicles, riot or civil commotion,

draw.label: Weight of snow, ice or sleet
Water from a system or appliance

beats.text: The 2012 Basic form names 11 perils, from fire to volcanic action. The others are lightning, explosion, windstorm or hail, smoke, aircraft or vehicles, riot or civil commotion, vandalism, sprinkler leakage and sinkhole collapse.
beats.say: The twenty twelve Basic form names eleven perils, from fire to volcanic action. The others are lightning, explosion, windstorm or hail, smoke, aircraft or vehicles, riot or civil commotion, vandalism, sprinkler leakage and sinkhole collapse.

beats.text: Broad is Basic plus a Michigan winter: falling objects, weight of snow, ice or sleet, and water damage from a system or appliance. Plus collapse coverage.
beats.say: Broad is Basic plus a Michigan winter: falling objects, weight of snow, ice or sleet, and water damage from a system or appliance. Plus collapse coverage.

beats.text: The 2017 Special form is open perils: it covers direct physical loss unless excluded or limited. Only Special covers theft.
beats.say: The twenty seventeen Special form is open perils: it covers direct physical loss unless excluded or limited. Only Special covers theft.

beats.text: Watch out: sprinkler leakage and sinkhole collapse are already Basic perils.
beats.say: Watch out: sprinkler leakage and sinkhole collapse are already Basic perils.

scenes.q: On a calm day, a tree limb falls through a store's roof. Which is the narrowest causes of loss form that covers the damage?
scenes.why: Falling objects is a peril Broad adds to Basic, and a calm day rules out windstorm. Special covers it too, but Broad is the narrowest form that does.

beats.text: Quick check: on a calm day, a limb crashes through a store's roof. Narrowest form?
beats.say: Quick check: on a calm day, a limb crashes through a store's roof. Narrowest form?

reveal.text: Broad: falling objects. A calm day rules out windstorm, a Basic peril. Special covers it too, but Broad is narrower.
reveal.say: Broad: falling objects. A calm day rules out windstorm, a Basic peril. Special covers it too, but Broad is narrower.

scenes.title: Empty for weeks: the vacancy rule
scenes.src: ISO CP 00 10 10 12, E.6.a-b (2012 Building and Personal Property form); hook mn_comm-06
scenes.plain: Too empty to count as in use. An owner's building is vacant unless at least 31% is rented and used, or used by the owner, for normal business.
scenes.example: Tony's warehouse sits unused for weeks while he waits for permits. Nobody works there, and nothing goes on inside.
scenes.exam: Over 60 days vacant: vandalism, building glass, water damage, theft, attempted theft unpaid; sprinkler leaks only if freeze-protected. Rest: less 15%.

beats.text: Tony's permits take forever, and the warehouse sits unused. Exam word: vacant. Vacancy is a loss condition in the Building and Personal Property form.
beats.say: Tony's permits take forever, and the warehouse sits unused. Exam word: vacant. Vacancy is a loss condition in the Building and Personal Property form.

beats.text: Vacant means too empty to count as in use. Under the 2012 form, an owner's building is vacant unless at least 31% is rented and used, or used by the owner, for customary operations. Tony's warehouse is vacant: for weeks, nobody works there, and nothing goes on inside.
beats.say: Vacant means too empty to count as in use. Under the twenty twelve form, an owner's building is vacant unless at least thirty-one percent is rented and used, or used by the owner, for customary operations. Tony's warehouse is vacant: for weeks, nobody works there, and nothing goes on inside.

beats.text: Vacant more than 60 consecutive days? Then vandalism, sprinkler leakage unless protected from freezing, building glass breakage, water damage, theft and attempted theft aren't paid. Other covered losses, like windstorm or fire, are cut 15%.
beats.say: Vacant more than sixty consecutive days? Then vandalism, sprinkler leakage unless protected from freezing, building glass breakage, water damage, theft and attempted theft aren't paid. Other covered losses, like windstorm or fire, are cut fifteen percent.

scenes.title: Day 50: what does Tony do?
scenes.src: ISO CP 00 10 10 12, E.6.a-b; hook mn_comm-06; question comm-021

beats.text: Day 50. Still empty, and the permits are weeks away. What does Tony do?
beats.say: Day fifty. Still empty, and the permits are weeks away. What does Tony do?

options.label: Leave it empty until spring
options.fail: After more than 60 consecutive days vacant, vandalism and building glass breakage aren't paid at all.

beats.text: Day 75: vandals tag the walls and smash the windows. Vacant over 60 days: none of it is paid.
beats.say: Day seventy-five: vandals tag the walls and smash the windows. Vacant over sixty days: none of it is paid.

options.label: Ask a buddy to check on it weekly
options.fail: Visits aren't use. Under 31% used for customary operations, it's still vacant, and other covered losses are cut 15%.

beats.text: Yep, still empty!
beats.say: Yep, still empty!
beats.speaker: Tony's buddy

beats.text: Day 80: a windstorm rips the roof. Visits aren't use, so it's still vacant: paid, minus 15%.
beats.say: Day eighty: a windstorm rips the roof. Visits aren't use, so it's still vacant: paid, minus fifteen percent.

options.label: Move his dough kitchen into 40% of it
options.win: With at least 31% used by the owner for customary operations, the building isn't vacant, so the vacancy rules don't apply.

beats.text: Tony's crew makes dough there now. With 40% in use, the warehouse isn't vacant.
beats.say: Tony's crew makes dough there now. With forty percent in use, the warehouse isn't vacant.

reveal.text: Keep at least 31% in real use. A building under renovation isn't vacant either, but Tony's work hadn't started.
reveal.say: Keep at least thirty-one percent in real use. A building under renovation isn't vacant either, but Tony's work hadn't started.

scenes.title: Tony's call: keep Basic?
scenes.src: ISO CP 10 10 10 12, A.; CP 10 20 10 12, A.12-14; CP 10 30 09 17, A., C.3; cp_commercial-06 drills; question comm-028

beats.text: Since Day 50, the kitchen hums.
beats.say: Since Day fifty, the kitchen hums.

beats.text: But heavy snow on that big roof? Thieves after my cheese? Is Basic enough?
beats.say: But heavy snow on that big roof? Thieves after my cheese? Is Basic enough?

options.label: Keep Basic. Winter can't be that bad!
options.fail: Weight of snow, ice or sleet isn't one of the 11 Basic perils. Broad adds it.

beats.text: February: heavy snow piles up and damages the roof. Weight of snow isn't a Basic peril.
beats.say: February: heavy snow piles up and damages the roof. Weight of snow isn't a Basic peril.

draw.text: Snow load: not a Basic peril

options.label: Upgrade to Broad. Sounds broad!
options.fail: Basic and Broad cover a burglar's damage to the building as vandalism, but not the theft itself. Only Special covers theft.

beats.text: Thieves break in and grab his cheese. Broad pays for the broken door, not the cheese.
beats.say: Thieves break in and grab his cheese. Broad pays for the broken door, not the cheese.

options.label: Upgrade to Special
options.win: Special covers direct physical loss unless excluded or limited. It's the only one of the three that covers theft.

beats.text: Snow on the roof, thieves at the door: Special covers both.
beats.say: Snow on the roof, thieves at the door: Special covers both.

reveal.text: The 2017 Special form puts thieves on a budget for a few items: $2,500 for furs, $2,500 for jewelry, $250 for stamps or tickets.
reveal.say: The twenty seventeen Special form puts thieves on a budget for a few items: two thousand five hundred dollars for furs, two thousand five hundred dollars for jewelry, two hundred fifty dollars for stamps or tickets.

scenes.title: Coinsurance: Did over Should
scenes.src: ISO CP 00 10 10 12, F.1 Coinsurance (2012 Building and Personal Property form); memory hook mn_comm-07; question comm-022

goal.text: Find the smallest limit that pays the whole $200,000 loss, minus only the $1,000 deductible.
goal.done: No penalty from $480,000 up: Did meets Should.

beats.text: That spring, a grease fire does $200,000 of damage. Deductible: $1,000.
beats.say: That spring, a grease fire does two hundred thousand dollars of damage. Deductible: one thousand dollars.

beats.text: Tony has 80% coinsurance: insure at least 80% of the building's value, or get paid only part.
beats.say: Tony has eighty percent coinsurance: insure at least eighty percent of the building's value, or get paid only part.

beats.text: Did over Should, times the Loss; take off the Deductible, and that's the insurer's cost.
beats.say: Did over Should, times the Loss; take off the Deductible, and that's the insurer's cost.

beats.text: At the time of loss, the building is worth $600,000.
beats.say: At the time of loss, the building is worth six hundred thousand dollars.

beats.text: You should carry $480,000. You carry $360,000.
beats.say: You should carry four hundred eighty thousand dollars. You carry three hundred sixty thousand dollars.

beats.text: Did over Should is three quarters: he gets $149,000. Find the smallest limit with no penalty.
beats.say: Did over Should is three quarters: he gets one hundred forty-nine thousand dollars. Find the smallest limit with no penalty.

reveal.text: $480,000: Did meets Should, so no penalty.
reveal.say: Four hundred eighty thousand dollars: Did meets Should, so no penalty.

reveal.text: Watch out: value counts at the time of loss, not when the policy was bought. And it never pays more than the limit.
reveal.say: Watch out: value counts at the time of loss, not when the policy was bought. And it never pays more than the limit.

scenes.title: Closed after the fire: Business Income
scenes.src: ISO CP 00 30 10 12, A.1-2, A.5.c, D., F.3 (2012 Business Income and Extra Expense form); cp_commercial-05
scenes.plain: Pays the profit you lose, plus bills that keep coming like payroll, while damage to your place keeps you closed.
scenes.example: The fire closes Tony's kitchen for two months. His Business Income form replaces the profit he loses and keeps his cooks' paychecks coming.
scenes.exam: Starts 72 hours after the loss; Extra Expense starts immediately. Extended Business Income: up to 60 days after reopening.

beats.text: The fire also shuts the kitchen.
beats.say: The fire also shuts the kitchen.

beats.text: Good thing we added the Business Income form, Tony.
beats.say: Good thing we added the Business Income form, Tony.

beats.text: Under the 2012 form, it pays lost net income plus continuing expenses, including payroll, while damage to your place keeps you closed. That's time element coverage: lost income, not damaged things.
beats.say: Under the twenty twelve form, it pays lost net income plus continuing expenses, including payroll, while damage to your place keeps you closed. That's time element coverage: lost income, not damaged things.

beats.text: Closed for two months! So my lost profit is covered, and my cooks still get paid?
beats.say: Closed for two months! So my lost profit is covered, and my cooks still get paid?

beats.text: Yes. But Business Income waits 72 hours after the direct physical loss. Extra Expense, the extra cost to keep operating, like a temporary location, starts immediately.
beats.say: Yes. But Business Income waits seventy-two hours after the direct physical loss. Extra Expense, the extra cost to keep operating, like a temporary location, starts immediately.

beats.text: After reopening, Extended Business Income adds up to 60 days. Coinsurance can apply to Business Income, never to Extra Expense.
beats.say: After reopening, Extended Business Income adds up to sixty days. Coinsurance can apply to Business Income, never to Extra Expense.

scenes.title: Business Income or Extra Expense?
scenes.src: ISO CP 00 30 10 12, A.1-2, A.5.c, F.3; cp_commercial-05 drills (incl. the dental office drill)

items.text: Profit Tony would have earned while closed
items.why: Lost net income during the shutdown is Business Income.

items.text: His cooks' payroll while the kitchen is closed
items.why: Continuing normal operating expenses, including payroll, are part of Business Income.

items.text: After a fire, a Traverse City dentist equips a temp office
items.why: Extra costs to avoid or minimize the shutdown are Extra Expense.

items.text: Slow sales for a few weeks after reopening
items.why: Extended Business Income runs after reopening, up to 60 days, while income gets back to normal.
Extra Expense starts at once; Business Income waits 72 hours.

items.text: The form's coinsurance condition doesn't apply to it
items.why: Coinsurance can apply to Business Income, not Extra Expense.

beats.text: Your turn: Business Income or Extra Expense?
beats.say: Your turn: Business Income or Extra Expense?

reveal.text: Lost profit and continuing bills while closed: Business Income. Extra money spent to keep going: Extra Expense.
reveal.say: Lost profit and continuing bills while closed: Business Income. Extra money spent to keep going: Extra Expense.

scenes.title: Ordinance or Law: A, B or C?
scenes.src: ISO CP 04 05 09 17, C.1-3; Causes of Loss forms B.1.a (ordinance or law); adapted from hook mn_comm-10; question comm-030

cards.text: The city makes Tony demolish the undamaged half and clear the site.
cards.why: Coverage B pays demolition cost: tearing down the undamaged parts and clearing the site.

cards.text: Tony loses the value of the undamaged half the city makes him tear down.
cards.why: Coverage A pays the loss to the undamaged portion of the building.

cards.text: Rebuilding to today's code costs more than rebuilding it the way it was.
cards.why: Coverage C pays the increased cost of construction from meeting the code's minimum standards.

beats.text: After the covered fire, the city's building code orders the undamaged part torn down. All three causes of loss forms exclude ordinance or law, so Dana had added that endorsement.
beats.say: After the covered fire, the city's building code orders the undamaged part torn down. All three causes of loss forms exclude ordinance or law, so Dana had added that endorsement.

beats.text: Tear down the half that didn't burn?
beats.say: Tear down the half that didn't burn?

beats.text: Think letters: A is All that's still standing, B is Bulldozer, C is Code upgrade. Your turn.
beats.say: Think letters: A is All that's still standing, B is Bulldozer, C is Code upgrade. Your turn.

reveal.text: A is the loss to the undamaged portion, B is demolition cost, C is the increased cost of construction.
reveal.say: A is the loss to the undamaged portion, B is demolition cost, C is the increased cost of construction.

scenes.title: Tony's call: protect the cheese
scenes.src: ISO CP 04 40 06 07, A., C.3, F.2; CP 12 30 06 95; CP 13 10 04 02; IRMI; comm-031, comm-cpa-06, comm-cpa-08

beats.text: Storms keep cutting Detroit's power, and Tony's cooler is full of cheese.
beats.say: Storms keep cutting Detroit's power, and Tony's cooler is full of cheese.

beats.text: Spoilage covers perishable stock for the causes you choose: Breakdown or Contamination, or Power Outage. Which one, Tony?
beats.say: Spoilage covers perishable stock for the causes you choose: Breakdown or Contamination, or Power Outage. Which one, Tony?

options.label: Peak Season: just raise my limit
options.fail: Peak Season raises the personal property limit only during scheduled dates, like a toy store's holiday rush. It isn't spoilage coverage.

beats.text: July: the power dies and the cheese spoils. A bigger limit adds no spoilage cover.
beats.say: July: the power dies and the cheese spoils. A bigger limit adds no spoilage cover.

draw.text: A bigger limit? The cheese still spoiled!

options.label: Spoilage: Breakdown or Contamination
options.fail: Breakdown or Contamination is for a refrigeration breakdown at the premises or refrigerant contamination. A storm outage needs Power Outage.

beats.text: July: a storm cuts the power and the cheese spoils. The cooler never broke down.
beats.say: July: a storm cuts the power and the cheese spoils. The cooler never broke down.

options.label: Spoilage: Power Outage
options.win: Power Outage covers power cuts beyond Tony's control, like storms. Breakdown or Contamination: a refrigeration breakdown or refrigerant contamination.

beats.text: A storm cuts the power and the cheese spoils. Covered: an outage beyond Tony's control.
beats.say: A storm cuts the power and the cheese spoils. Covered: an outage beyond Tony's control.

reveal.text: Peak Season raises the personal property limit only on scheduled dates, like a toy store's holiday rush.
reveal.say: Peak Season raises the personal property limit only on scheduled dates, like a toy store's holiday rush.

reveal.text: Value Reporting fits inventory that rises and falls: a limit set for peak values, but premium on the values reported.
reveal.say: Value Reporting fits inventory that rises and falls: a limit set for peak values, but premium on the values reported.

scenes.title: Four more property forms on Tony's block

spots.label: Condominium Association form
spots.text: Covers the association's building. It's primary, and its insurer waives subrogation: it can't recover from unit-owners, even one who carelessly starts a fire.

spots.label: Condo Commercial Unit-Owners form
spots.text: A dentist owns her office unit here. Her form covers her business personal property and is excess over the association's insurance.

spots.label: Builders Risk (1995 form)
spots.text: Covers a building under construction, including materials and supplies meant to become a permanent part of it.

spots.label: Legal Liability form
spots.text: The bakery rents its building. This form covers its legal liability for damage to the landlord's building from a covered cause of loss.

beats.text: Tony's block needs four more property forms. Tap each glowing spot.
beats.say: Tony's block needs four more property forms. Tap each glowing spot.

reveal.text: The association's form is primary and waives subrogation; a unit-owner's is excess. Builders risk covers buildings going up; legal liability, others' property in your care.
reveal.say: The association's form is primary and waives subrogation; a unit-owner's is excess. Builders risk covers buildings going up; legal liability, others' property in your care.

scenes.title: Key takeaways
items: Broad adds falling objects, snow and ice weight, water damage
Vacant over 60 days: some losses not paid, the rest cut 15%
Coinsurance: Did over Should, times the loss, minus the deductible
Business Income waits 72 hours; Extra Expense starts at once
Ordinance or Law: A undamaged part, B demolition, C code upgrade

beats.text: What a year! Broad adds a Michigan winter: falling objects, the weight of snow and ice, and water damage. Only Special covers theft. Vacant over 60 days? Some losses out, the rest cut 15%. Coinsurance: Did over Should, times the loss, minus the deductible.
beats.say: What a year! Broad adds a Michigan winter: falling objects, the weight of snow and ice, and water damage. Only Special covers theft. Vacant over sixty days? Some losses out, the rest cut fifteen percent. Coinsurance: Did over Should, times the loss, minus the deductible.

beats.text: Business Income waits 72 hours; Extra Expense starts at once. Ordinance or Law: A is the undamaged part, B is demolition, C is code upgrade.
beats.say: Business Income waits seventy-two hours; Extra Expense starts at once. Ordinance or Law: A is the undamaged part, B is demolition, C is code upgrade.

beats.text: From now on, my warehouse stays busy.
beats.say: From now on, my warehouse stays busy.
